code: class Solution { public int rotatedDigits(int n){int ans=0;for(int x=1;x<=n;x++){int v=x;boolean valid=true,changed=false;while(v>0){int d=v%10;if(d==3||d==4||d==7){valid=false;break;}if(d==2||d==5||d==6||d==9)changed=true;v/=10;}if(valid&&changed)ans++;}return ans;} }
complexity_reason: Reject any number containing 3, 4, or 7; count it only if it contains at least one of 2, 5, 6, or 9.

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<String> subdomainVisits(String[] cpdomains){Map<String,Integer>m=new HashMap<>();for(String item:cpdomains){String[]p=item.split(" ");int n=Integer.parseInt(p[0]);String[]labels=p[1].split("\\.");for(int i=0;i<labels.length;i++){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(int j=i;j<labels.length;j++){if(j>i)b.append('.');b.append(labels[j]);}m.put(b.toString(),m.getOrDefault(b.toString(),0)+n);}}List<String>out=new ArrayList<>();for(String d:m.keySet())out.add(m.get(d)+" "+d);return out;} }

Invariant: Extract alphabetic tokens in lowercase, skip banned words, and select the highest-frequency token.
Edge cases: Check empty or singleton inputs where permitted, boundaries, and minimal structures.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String mostCommonWord(String paragraph,String[] banned){Set<String>ban=new HashSet<>();for(String w:banned)ban.add(w.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));Map<String,Integer>count=new HashMap<>();String best="";int max=0;for(String w:paragraph.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).split("[^a-z]+")){if(w.isEmpty()||ban.contains(w))continue;int n=count.getOrDefault(w,0)+1;count.put(w,n);if(n>max){max=n;best=w;}}return best;} }
complexity_reason: Extract alphabetic tokens in lowercase, skip banned words, and select the highest-frequency token.

title: Shortest Distance to a Character

Idea: Sweep left-to-right for the previous occurrence and right-to-left for the next occurrence, keeping the smaller distance.
Invariant: Sweep left-to-right for the previous occurrence and right-to-left for the next occurrence, keeping the smaller distance.
Edge cases: Check empty or singleton inputs where permitted, boundaries, and minimal structures.
code: class Solution { public int[] shortestToChar(String s,char c){int n=s.length();int[]a=new int[n];int last=-n;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(s.charAt(i)==c)last=i;a[i]=i-last;}last=2*n;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){if(s.charAt(i)==c)last=i;a[i]=Math.min(a[i],last-i);}return a;} }
